items.prompt: Which handover best supports recreating a numerical result?

options.text: Source revision, run command, versions and input/seed assumptions
options.why: These record the conditions needed to repeat the checked run.

options.text: Only a screenshot of the final output number
options.why: That omits the code, inputs and environment.

options.text: Only the claim that it worked on one unnamed machine
Only a random seed, without code or library versions
options.why: Seeds can depend on the algorithm/version and execution path.

items.explanation: Reproducibility needs enough information to recreate the checked conditions. A seed or screenshot alone does not specify them.
